Resolves #21926

Removes `multi-window-drag-drop` (`apps/shareddialog`) from `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/multi-window.json` (which also removes its cross-listings in Apps and Drag & Drop), opts `apps/shareddialog/neo-config.json` out of standalone SEO/sitemap indexing (`"seo": false`), and updates `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` plus the Drag & Drop group sentence and `<title>` (`dialogs dragged` / `Boards, Lists & Panes`) now that no Drag & Drop card drags a dialog across windows. `apps/shareddialog` stays on disk for its two existing E2E specs.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline guards and `npx neo-agent-skills-pr-body` ran (`change-class: zero-delta` → `chore(portal)`).

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium `1440×900` Neo Dark Multi-Window renders, `getSitemapXml()` check, and both `apps/shareddialog` E2E specs) → L3 required (AC-3, AC-4). Residual: none.

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained. One catalog record leaves, and its counts, titles and SEO page follow. No architectural concept is involved.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim (AC-1, AC-2) is that `multi-window-drag-drop` leaves every group it appeared in, and stays out of `seo.json` and the sitemap. I checked it at `9c86130396`:
- **Record:** removed from `multi-window.json`. Its `alsoIn` took it out of Apps and Drag & Drop with it. The only remaining mention of its id is the new `not.toContain` assertion, and its cover `multi_window_dd.png` is no longer referenced.
- **Durability:** `"seo": false` in `apps/shareddialog/neo-config.json` is read by `collectExampleRoutes` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs`, `neoConfig?.seo === false`). The next regeneration therefore leaves `/apps/shareddialog/index.html` out too; the removal is not a one-time hand edit.
- **Counts:** Apps and Drag & Drop go 12 → 11, which matches the group files at the head. Multi-Window goes 10 → 9. The generator counts that group two lower than a raw family-or-`alsoIn` count, on `dev` (12 vs 10) and at the head (11 vs 9) alike, so the decrement is consistent.
- **Copy:** "dialogs dragged" and "Boards, Lists & Panes" match what we settled on the Tier 2.5 thread. Without this record, none of the 11 Drag & Drop entries crosses a window.
- **Tests and look:** the two specs that load the app are unchanged (AC-3). The Multi-Window frames are in the body (AC-4). Required checks 7/7 green.

I looked for a leftover reference that would break the build or a capture spec: a recipe, a featured pin, or a sitemap row naming the record or the app. I found none outside history files, generated docs, and a code comment in `Viewport.mjs`.

**Findings:** None.
